recommended_actions.text: Check orders-db-9d9 for failover, promotion, replica role changes, or maintenance activity around 2024-01-05T08:10:00Z, and confirm whether the database entered a read-only state during the incident window.

Review orders-db-9d9 configuration and recent change history for any read-only setting, routing change, or other misconfiguration near onset to determine whether a config change caused the write failures.
